blocks.html: A permanent factory-applied nameplate(s) shall be affixed to appliances on which shall appear in legible lettering: the manufacturer's name or trademark, the model number, serial number and, for listed appliances, the seal or mark of the testing agency. A label shall include the hourly rating in British thermal units per hour (Btu/h) (W), the type of fuel approved for use with the appliance, and the minimum clearance requirements.
